id: title:Gilbert09:treat exceeded result size limits as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Updates warehouse ingestion failure classification for ClickHouse result size limits, distinguishing configuration issues from transient failures.
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable error entry for ClickHouse error code 396 and corresponding test assertions, changing warehouse ingestion behavior from transient retry to user remediation.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk observations; no broader context or execution results available.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for ClickHouse error code 396 (TOO_MANY_ROWS_OR_BYTES) in the shared error-handling dictionary, alongside existing entries for code 243.
observations.code_quote: "TOO_MANY_ROWS_OR_BYTES": "Your ClickHouse server's result size limit was exceeded while reading this table. Raise the max_result_bytes/max_result_rows limit for the user PostHog connects with, sync fewer columns, or switch this table to an incremental sync so each run reads a smaller window, then resume.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change updates PostHog's warehouse ingestion failure classification. It ensures that when ClickHouse-compatible endpoints return the specific error message for result size limits, PostHog's ingestion tests recognize this failure and do not incorrectly classify it as a transient network or transient database error.
